review.why: Builds multi-component React artifacts with Tailwind and shadcn/ui and bundles them into one self-contained HTML file.
review.summary: Initializes a React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind and shadcn/ui project with a script, lets the agent develop it, then bundles everything with Parcel into a single inlined HTML file to share as an artifact. Testing is optional and done after presenting. Design guidance warns against centered layouts, purple gradients and uniform rounded corners.
strengths: One script sets up the full project with forty-plus components
A bundle script inlines everything into a single HTML file
Explicit guidance against generic AI layouts
cautions: Aimed at artifacts in one vendor's chat apps
Installs packages through npm at run time
The shell scripts and the bundled component archive are not read here
